atlases.name: lit-atlas
atlases.title: Literary Atlas
atlases.about: World literature mapped by place, time, concepts and cultural values: 166 works from Gilgamesh to Han Kang.

atlases.name: cine-atlas
atlases.title: Cine Atlas
atlases.about: World cinema organised by the questions films ask and the values they put at stake, with the connections between them.

atlases.name: trans-atlas
atlases.title: TRANS-ATLAS
atlases.about: Events of human history on a map and a timeline, with verifiable metrics and sound comparisons (in Italian).

atlases.name: math-map
atlases.title: Atlante Matematico
atlases.about: A concept map of the main domains, concepts and tools of mathematics (in Italian).

atlases.name: scifi-map
atlases.title: Atlas of Imagined Futures
atlases.about: Science fiction literature as a star chart: 230 works, from Lucian to the present, in fifteen thematic sectors.

atlases.name: cc-map
atlases.title: Atlante dei campi
atlases.about: Concentration, extermination, forced-labour and internment camps around the world, from the 19th century to today (in Italian).

atlases.name: lang-map
atlases.title: Linguistic Drift
atlases.about: How languages change: a concept map of linguistic drift and a world map of 233 languages through time.

atlases.name: beatgen-map
atlases.title: Beat Atlas
atlases.about: The Beat Generation's apartments, bars, bookshops, courtrooms and graves, 1944-1997, drawn like a mid-century road map.

atlases.name: story
atlases.title: Story Builder
atlases.about: An infographic story builder grounded in Robert McKee's STORY, with an optional AI character agent.

atlases.name: char-build
atlases.title: CharBuild
atlases.about: A character builder after McKee's CHARACTER: structured, visual and interactive, with an optional AI coach.

atlases.name: dialoguedevil
atlases.title: Dialogue Devil
atlases.about: A dialogue builder grounded in McKee's DIALOGUE, with optional AI character coaching.

atlases.name: astrum
atlases.title: Astrum
atlases.about: Astrophysics in twelve interactive plates, from the scale of the cosmos to the expansion of the Universe, drawn from real catalogues.

atlases.name: universe-map
atlases.title: Universe Map
atlases.about: A 3D map of the universe you can fly through: the Solar System to scale, 100,000 nearby stars and the cosmos out to the microwave background.

atlases.name: qtr-v2
atlases.title: QTR System
atlases.about: The fifteen codices of the QTR universe: its physics, cartography, timelines, bestiary and languages.

atlases.name: outliner
atlases.title: Outliner
atlases.about: A private, local-first outliner in the style of Dynalist, with a dark VS Code look. Your notes stay in this browser.

atlases.name: draftist
atlases.title: Draftist
atlases.about: A writing workspace for novelists: one continuous manuscript with an outline, a searchable story bible, comments and paper, sepia or night views.

atlases.name: orchestrator
atlases.title: Storyline
atlases.about: A timeline plotter for stories. Projects are saved as .storyline files in the app's projects folder.

atlases.name: vdc-spiral
atlases.title: Spiral
atlases.about: A story relationship diagram: characters on intimacy circles, a golden-ratio spiral and Fibonacci arms, exported as PNG.

atlases.name: persona2
atlases.title: PERSONA 2
atlases.about: A local-first lab for persistent AI characters built with McKee's method, talking through LM Studio or another LLM (in Italian by default).
